result.quote: So the old prophet lifted up the body of the man of God, laid it on the donkey, and brought it back to his own city to mourn for him and bury him.
result.reason: The key is supported as a paraphrase of his burying the man in his own tomb, but the question is too broad to make it unique. The old prophet also lifts the body, places it on the donkey, brings it to the city, and lays it in his tomb. The question should specify that it is asking where he buries or lays the body.
